title: Thornwood Demo
author: Nakiz123
selftext:
I've been working on this for a few months now and finally have a demo I'm okay showing people. It's called THORNROAD, a pixel action platformer with bosses, a handful of heroes and couch co-op. Plays in the browser, nothing to download:



[https://draphael123.itch.io/thornroad](https://draphael123.itch.io/thornroad)

  
The game is built with Claude Code. It writes the code, and the pixel art is drawn in code too, so there are no hand-made sprite sheets. My part is the design and the direction: what the levels and bosses should be, playing every build, and sending back notes on what feels wrong until it's fixed. A typical day is me playing a level, writing up what's off, and going through a few rounds of changes. There's also an automated test suite that plays the levels with bots before anything goes live, because otherwise things break constantly.



The demo is the first dozen levels and ends at the first big boss. The full game is planned at around 80 levels. About 60 of those are built, but the ones outside the demo still need a lot of work, so I'm only putting up the part I think holds together.



It still needs work in places. Touch controls are rough, and some of the balance is probably off. I've played these levels too many times to tell anymore, which is mostly why I'm posting.



Any feedback is welcome, good or bad. There's a feedback button in the game, or just reply here. Thanks!
